fields.description: The Row Saadiyat brings one to three-bedroom apartments to Saadiyat Cultural District. Designed with BIG, the neighbourhood places homes alongside dining, retail and wellness spaces connected by shaded and cooled pedestrian routes.

overview: The project pairs residential buildings with everyday destinations rather than treating retail as a distant add-on. Aldar lists fitness studios, coworking spaces and a pet spa within the wider offer. Confirm which facilities are included in the residential service charge and which require a separate membership.
research.locationNote: The Row sits in Saadiyat Cultural District on Saadiyat Island. The launch announcement identifies Zayed National Museum as its backdrop. Views and walking connections vary by home and completed phase.
research.priceNote: The reviewed launch table starts at AED 3.7m, corroborated by Property Finder. Obtain a current quotation for the selected apartment.
research.paymentNote: Original 65/35 schedule shown below. It describes the launch terms, not the balance due on an assignment or a later promotional plan.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment table uses 29 January 2030; the fact sheet states Q1 2030. Confirm the selected building’s contractual completion date and subsequent notices.
